title: Andrew Forbes's smoking and adult-asthma model
content: Forbes's full model embeds Deconfounding Game 5 and adds parental asthma, chronic bronchitis, sex, and socioeconomic status. The observed set A, B, E, F, and G is sufficient for estimating the effect of smoking on adult asthma.

variables.name: Parental Smoking (A)
variables.content: Parental smoking affects childhood asthma and later smoking.

variables.name: Parental Asthma (D)
variables.content: Parental asthma affects parental smoking and inherited predisposition.

variables.name: Chronic Bronchitis (E)
variables.content: Chronic bronchitis affects smoking and adult asthma.

variables.name: Sex (F)
variables.content: Sex affects predisposition, smoking, and adult asthma.

variables.name: Socioeconomic Status (G)
variables.content: Socioeconomic status affects smoking and adult asthma.

variables.name: Smoking (X)
variables.content: The exposure whose causal effect is sought.
